name: rehearse
description: Makes the agent see a bug happen, or do a new program's job by hand, before it changes code. It registers the ending (the command and the result it must show), you confirm it in plain words, and an independent director checks the work before it may finish. Turn it on by starting a prompt with 'rehearse'.

confirm_ending.title: Confirm the ending
confirm_ending.description: Ask you to confirm the ending before any edit. Turn off for unattended runs; the director reviews it instead.

max_rejections.title: Director rejections
max_rejections.description: How many times the director may send the work back before the run ends with a not fixed report.

loop_breaker_rounds.title: Loop breaker rounds
loop_breaker_rounds.description: Failing edit rounds with no direct look before edits lock again.

director_model.title: Director model
director_model.description: The model the director runs on.
